row: Ailucs is a dynamic professional medical diode laser system manufacturer.The company brings together an experienced professional team with more than 20 years of industry experience. Since its establishment, Ailucs has relied on top global software and hardware talents to focus on independent research and development, design, and manufacturing integration. We always prioritize customer needs and provide various high-quality and reasonably priced systems for hospitals, clinics, and doctors worldwide, including dental lasers, surgical lasers, veterinary lasers, and aesthetic lasers.
